text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
Home(x, y) ::: x is home to y.
Premises:
City(billings) ∧ City(butte) ∧ City(helena) ∧ City(missoula) ∧ State(billings, montana) ∧ State(butte, montana) ∧ State(helena, montana) ∧ State(missoula, montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana. Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
SameState(whiteSulphurSprings, butte) ∧ State(whiteSulphurSprings, montana) ∧ State(butte, montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
¬State(pierre, montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (City(x) ∧ State(x, butte) → ¬State(x, pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
¬Home(montana, missoula) ::: Montana is not home to the city of Missoula.
